text:
samir patel: morning — quick onboarding q's: my health benefits card hasn't arrived, paycard balance shows $0, and i'm traveling for a visa appointment Mon — who do I submit any travel reimbursement to? also how does PTO prorate if i start mid-month? thanks! (first week)

alex ng: welcome! cc @joanne (People Ops) and @ben (Payroll)

joanne (People Ops): hi Samir — welcome! :wave: for the benefits card — typically mailed in 7–10 business days. Check the benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com with your work email. If not there in 10 days, DM me and i'll escalate.

maria (Benefits): adding — if you enrolled during onboarding the plan is active from your effective date in Workday. To re-request a card: go to the portal > 'ID cards' and click 'request replacement'. Keep a photo of your insurance s.t. our vendor can expedite.

ben (Payroll): paycards: first pay cycle posts after new hire payroll runs. Check Pay > Payment method in Workday. If your bank/paycard info looks wrong DM me a screenshot (mask digits). If you need an advance for travel, we can do an emergency reimbursement.

people-ops-bot: reminder: benefits enrollment window closes in 9 days. See: https://intra.redwood/benefits-deadlines

samir patel: thx — for emergency reimbursement, what's the workflow?

joanne (People Ops): for short-term travel/visa costs: email receipts@redwood.com with subject 'Expense: Visa - Samir Patel' and attach receipts. Put 'HR-EXP:4571' in the body to routeto Payroll. We'll process via Ramp within 5 business days.

ben (Payroll): also include approval from your manager in the email. cc me and i'll triage.

alex ng: note for PTO prorate — per policy you get prorated accrual for your first partial month. People Ops can confirm exact days once start date is in Workday.

joanne (People Ops): confirmed — prorate is (monthly accrual * days employed / days in month). i'll compute and DM you the number. i've filed ticket HR-4571 to expedite the card and pinged payroll. expect an update by EOD Tue.

samir patel: awesome, appreciate it! :thumbsup:

maria (Benefits): ping me if you plan to add dependents — that may delay card mailing if we need verification docs.

samir patel: noted — will DM. thanks everyone!
